description.value:
This rugged steel box has a wide mouth on one side and an ammo feed on the other. It uses nanites to convert scrap fed to the bin into battery charges, chemical fuel, or projectiles. Generated chems or projectiles are held in shape by the device's magnetic field, so they disintegrate into useless junk if removed from the installed weapon.

Activate—Recycle Ammo 1 (manipulate)

Effect You pour 1 Bulk of junk into the junk hopper. At the start of your next turn, the hopper finishes converting the junk into 10 chems, 10 battery charges, or 10 rounds of projectile ammo, which are automatically loaded into the installed weapon. Any ammunition produced that exceeds the installed weapon's magazine capacity is wasted.
